title: Vector Putt
description: A physics mini-golf game with a slingshot putt, sand/water/ramp hazards, and a full course editor you can save and share.
concept: Pull back from the ball to aim and release to putt across six hand-built courses with real circle-vs-wall collision, sand friction, water hazards, and directional ramps. Build your own courses in a grid-based level editor, save them to your device, or generate a shareable link that encodes the whole course in the URL.
features: 6 built-in courses with increasing difficulty (walls, sand, water, ramps)
Slingshot-style drag-to-aim putting with a live power/direction preview
Full course editor: paint walls, sand, water, 4-way ramps, start & hole
Save custom courses to localStorage and share via a self-contained URL hash
Per-course best-score tracking, par ratings (Eagle/Birdie/Par/Bogey), procedural sound effects

interaction.mouse: Drag from the ball to aim (slingshot pull-back), release to putt. Click cards on the menu to pick a course.
interaction.click: Toolbar buttons select editor tools; card clicks load courses.
interaction.touch: Same drag-to-aim gesture works with touch; editor painting works via tap/drag.
interaction.keyboard: R restarts the hole, M returns to the menu, Esc cancels an in-progress aim.
